description: Pinned upstream source for the native PTY artifact pi-agents ships. build.mjs verifies every field here fail-closed; nothing is resolved at build time and nothing is fetched at install time.

license.note: Upstream publishes no license file: neither the npm tarball nor the repository root at github.com/replit/ruspty contains LICENSE, and the only licence statement is the package.json "license": "MIT" field recorded here. No third-party licence text is reproduced in this repository, because inventing a copyright holder line would be worse than recording the absence.

platform.note: One artifact, one platform. The crate links glibc, libgcc_s, libm and the loader, so the shipped binary runs on linux-x64 glibc only; musl, arm64 and non-Linux hosts have no artifact and the mechanism refuses them by name rather than loading something that cannot work.
